verses.he: שִׁ֗יר הַֽמַּ֫עֲל֥וֹת רַ֭בַּת צְרָר֣וּנִי מִנְּעוּרַ֑י יֹֽאמַר־נָ֝א יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.en: A Song of Ascents. 'Much have they afflicted me from my youth up', Let Israel now say;

verses.he: רַ֭בַּת צְרָר֣וּנִי מִנְּעוּרָ֑י גַּ֝ם לֹא־יָ֥כְלוּ לִֽי׃
verses.en: 'Much have they afflicted me from my youth up; But they have not prevailed against me.
The plowers plowed upon my back; They made long their furrows.
The LORD is righteous; He hath cut asunder the cords of the wicked.'

verses.he: יֵ֭בֹשׁוּ וְיִסֹּ֣גוּ אָח֑וֹר כֹּ֝֗ל שֹׂנְאֵ֥י צִיּֽוֹן׃
verses.en: Let them be ashamed and turned backward, All they that hate Zion.

verses.he: יִ֭הְיוּ כַּחֲצִ֣יר גַּגּ֑וֹת שֶׁקַּדְמַ֖ת שָׁלַ֣ף יָבֵֽשׁ׃
verses.en: Let them be as the grass upon the housetops, Which withereth afore it springeth up;

verses.he: שֶׁלֹּ֤א מִלֵּ֖א כַפּ֥וֹ קוֹצֵ֗ר וְחִצְנ֥וֹ מְעַמֵּֽר׃
verses.en: Wherewith the reaper filleth not his hand, Nor he that bindeth sheaves his bosom.

verses.he: וְלֹ֤א אָֽמְר֨וּ׀ הָעֹבְרִ֗ים בִּרְכַּֽת־יְהוָ֥ה אֲלֵיכֶ֑ם בֵּרַ֥כְנוּ אֶ֝תְכֶ֗ם בְּשֵׁ֣ם יְהוָֽה׃
verses.en: Neither do they that go by say: ‘The blessing of the LORD be upon you; We bless you in the name of the LORD.'
